description: Equipped with a patented new technology, the Vindicator uses extra-dimensional interference to overload enemy sensors, making it the primary target. The Vindicator harvests energy from the subsequent onslaught to increase the power of its own weapons. This ship was built to take damage, and return it with a vengeance.

ship_ability.title: Unfettered Revenge
ship_ability.description:
Increases Weapon Damage by {value} for 5 rounds each time you are hit by an Armada (cumulative).
(Weapons with multiple shots will only trigger this ability once per attack.)
